page.layout: Two medallion portraits side by side at the top, each with its inscription around the rim, read as lines. Below them one column of running text, then one short paragraph at the foot of the page. The running head is at the top centre and the page number at the top right. No marginal notes.

page.notes: The two medallion inscriptions are set in the engraved rims; the right-hand one ("DOMITIA CAL. AEL. VER. XX") is uncertain in its spacing and numeral. The first paragraph is set in full; no word is marked [?] in the body text. Long s is read as plain s throughout, and the printed "effet" is transcribed as "esset".
